Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored a goal on five shots and added an assist in Tuesday's 6-3 loss to the Bruins.
Celebrini scored his first goal of the season in Saturday's 3-1 loss to the Oilers.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard notched two assists, including one on the power play, and added two hits, two blocked shots and a plus-2 rating in Tuesday's 4-1 win over the Kings.
Bouchard scored twice on four shots, added a power-play assist and went plus-4 in Wednesday's 5-2 win over the Ducks.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider recorded a power-play assist, placed three shots on net, had four blocked shots and dished out a hit in Sunday's 3-2 loss to Winnipeg.
Seider is looking to take another step in his game during the 2026-27 season following an uncertain offseason for the Red Wings, Shawn P. Roarke of NHL.com reports.
Moritz Seider.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Shawn P. Roarke (NHL.com)

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes scored the game-winning goal and added two assists, one on the power play, in Tuesday's 5-4 overtime victory over the Red Wings.
Hughes notched two power-play assists in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Canucks.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier notched an assist and four shots on goal in Friday's 4-2 loss to the Bruins.
Gauthier (upper body) will be in the lineup to face Boston on Friday, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports.
Cutter Gauthier.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Derek Lee (The Hockey News)

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a goal on two shots, added an assist, logged six PIM and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 5-4 win over the Maple Leafs.
Guenther scored a goal and added two assists, all on the power play, in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Blue Jackets.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun scored a power-play goal, recorded an assist, placed three shots on net and served two PIM in Friday's 5-2 win over the Hurricanes.
Chychrun scored a power-play goal in Tuesday's 2-1 win over the Blue Jackets.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored twice on three shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 5-4 win over the Canadiens.
Tuch scored a goal on six shots, blocked two shots and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman allowed three goals on 38 shots in Tuesday's 6-3 win over the Sharks.
Swayman will defend the road crease in Tuesday's road clash against the Sharks, per Adam Pellerin of NESN.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Adam Pellerin (NESN.)

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke scored a goal on six shots and added two PIM in Tuesday's 4-1 loss to the Oilers.
Clarke logged two assists, including one on the power play, and added five shots on goal, two blocked shots and a minus-2 rating in Saturday's 5-4 overtime loss to the Sharks.

Tom Wilson.summary: Wilson scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Friday's 3-1 win over the Rangers. He also added three hits.
Wilson scored a goal on two shots, added two assists, logged two hits, blocked two shots and went plus-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a power-play goal on three shots and added an assist in Thursday's 4-3 overtime win over the Jets.
Bedard tallied a power-play assist, posted a plus-1 rating and placed three shots on net in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Pittsburgh.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck (suspension) is not listed on the Jets' official roster, per the NHL media site Friday.
Hellebuyck has been suspended by the Jets for not reporting to training camp Wednesday amid his ongoing confrontation with the team regarding his trade request.

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal Thursday in a 7-1 loss to New Jersey.
Dorofeyev registered a goal and an assist in Thursday's 5-1 win over the Lightning.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored three goals, including one on the power play, in Thursday's 6-2 win over the Flames.
Stone notched two power-play assists in Saturday's 2-1 overtime win over the Kings.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored the game-winning goal and added an assist in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Ottawa.
Faulk scored a goal on two shots in Wednesday's 8-1 loss to the Panthers.

Jet Greaves.summary: Greaves turned aside all four shots he faced after replacing Cam Talbot early in the third period of Tuesday's 7-3 loss to the Panthers.
Greaves allowed four goals on 26 shots in Saturday's 5-3 loss to the Blues. St. Louis' fifth goal was an empty-netter.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a goal on two shots and added two PIM in Tuesday's 5-4 loss to the Mammoth.
McKenna picked up a power-play assist Saturday in a 6-3 win over Colorado.

Shea Theodore.summary: Theodore scored a goal on four shots and blocked two shots in Friday's 4-3 loss to the Ducks.
Theodore logged two assists, including one on the power play, and a plus-2 rating in Tuesday's 5-2 win over the Blackhawks.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek notched two assists, including one on the power play, and added three shots on net and four hits in Thursday's 5-4 win over the Blues.
Eriksson Ek scored an empty-net goal on three shots, added three hits and went plus-2 in Monday's 4-2 win over the Golden Knights.

Jimmy Snuggerud.summary: Snuggerud scored two goals on three shots in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Blue Jackets.
Snuggerud scored an empty-net goal on four shots, dished an assist and went plus-2 in Friday's 4-0 win over the Stars.

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund (upper body) will be with the Ducks for their upcoming four-game road trip, Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports Friday.
Mikael Granlund.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Patrick Present (The Hockey News)

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund (upper body) wasn't on the ice for Friday's morning skate, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports, indicating that he isn't expected to play against the Bruins.
Mikael Granlund.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Derek Lee (The Hockey News)

Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Evan Rawal (Denver Gazette)

Jared McCann.summary: McCann ripped a power-play goal in Thursday's 4-3 overtime loss to the Lightning.
McCann scored a goal on two shots in Sunday's 5-3 win over the Capitals.

Carter Hart.summary: Hart stopped 28 of 30 shots in Thursday's 6-2 win over the Flames.
Hart is expected to start at home against Calgary on Thursday, per Danny Webster of the Las Vegas Review-Journal.
Carter Hart.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Danny Webster (Las Vegas Review-Journal.)
